New York: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open New York on the map

Key dates

  • Voter registration deadline: October 24, 2026. Applies to registering online, in person, or by mail. Mailed applications must reach your county board of elections by this date.
  • Early voting: October 24, 2026 to November 1, 2026. Early voting sites and hours are set by each county board of elections.
  • Last day to request an early mail or absentee ballot: October 24, 2026. The board of elections must receive mail or online applications by this date. You can still apply in person at your county board of elections until November 2. A mailed ballot must be postmarked by November 3.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open 6 a.m. to 9 p.m.

Official election information: vote.gov

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.

State

Governor and Lt. Governor

Governor and lieutenant governor are elected together on one ticket for a four-year term. Incumbent Governor Kathy C. Hochul is running for re-election with Adrienne E. Adams as her running mate. Bruce A. Blakeman's running mate is Todd Hood.
